simple.meaning: מִצְפֶּה (mitspeh) is a Hebrew word meaning “an observatory , especially for military purposes.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִצְפֶּה (H4707) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Chronicles 20:24, with occurrences in 2 Chronicles, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִצְפֶּה (H4707) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִצְפֶּה (H4707) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִצְפֶּה (mitspeh) / H4707 is traced through 2 Chronicles 20:24, Isaiah 21:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
